axes.xDefinition: log10 stellar mass estimated from the K-band magnitude M_K
axes.yDefinition: fraction of slow rotators among early-type galaxies in the mass bin, f_slow = N_slow/N_total

selection.population: early-type galaxies only: MASSIVE priority sample (M_K<-25.5, 75 galaxies, volume limited) + ATLAS3D early-type sample; late types are not included
selection.warning: Nine mass bins combining ATLAS3D (log M* 9.9-11.7) and MASSIVE (11.7-12.2) early-type galaxies; x is the bin centre in the figure's M_K-derived mass, xLow/xHigh the bin edges. Only early-type galaxies enter: this is NOT the slow-rotator fraction of all galaxies. Counts are small at low mass (3/43, 4/51, 6/37, 6/68): binomial errors are not given in the paper. zMax=0.03 is a rounding of D<108 Mpc (MASSIVE) assuming H0~70, not a paper statement.

definitions.massDefinition: K-band luminosity proxy: M_* from M_K via equation 2 of Ma+14, taken from eq. 2 of Cappellari+13 (massive_vii.tex lines 223-224)
definitions.projection: 2D observed line-of-sight IFS velocity and dispersion maps; circular bins for MASSIVE, elliptical apertures for ATLAS3D (line 514); many ATLAS3D galaxies do not reach R_e (half to between 0.5 R_e and R_e)
definitions.slowRotatorCriterion: slow rotator if lambda_e < 0.31 sqrt(epsilon) (Emsellem+11 cutoff used 'hereafter', massive_vii.tex lines 516 and 519); no separate epsilon < 0.4 limit is stated
definitions.spinDefinition: lambda(<R) = <R|V|>/<R sqrt(V^2+sigma^2)>, lambda_e = lambda(<R_e); angle brackets are luminosity-weighted averages over all IFS bins within R (massive_vii.tex lines 506-508)

provenance.citation: Veale et al. 2017, MNRAS 471, 1428 (arXiv:1703.08573), Fig. 'lam-mk' (spin parameter and slow rotator fraction versus M*)
provenance.figure: Fig. lam-mk: spin parameter (top) and slow rotator fraction (bottom) versus M*
provenance.extractionMethod: vector paths of the figure PDF (PyMuPDF): step-line segments, marker centres and the n/N text labels
provenance.axisCalibrationPixels: x: top log axis, decade labels 10^10-10^12 validated on the minor ticks; y: major ticks + numeric labels; f_slow geometry equals the printed n/N to <0.003

records.notes: y = n_slow/N printed on the figure (e.g. 6/68, 8/9); the plotted step heights agree with n/N to <0.003. MASSIVE bins re-derived from the paper's table: 58 slow of 75, top bin 8/9.
